headline: Oil Prices Plunge Over 4% on Hopes of US-Iran War Deal
summary: Oil prices fell more than 4% as diplomatic agreement hopes concerning the US-Israeli war on Iran eased concerns about further disruptions to global crude supplies.
why: Crude oil is a primary global energy commodity and a key input for transportation, manufacturing, and petrochemicals, directly influencing global inflation and energy sector equities.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Hopes of eased supply disruptions directly weigh on crude oil prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Crude oil prices dropped more than 4% as optimism regarding a diplomatic agreement to end the conflict eased concerns over potential global crude supply disruptions.
